title: 第11章 另辟蹊径做大梦第12章 轻戳窗户纸仇怨心中来
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
另辟蹊径做大梦。
楚家，大厅。
“大长老，我们真的要跟李家合作吗？”楚家家主看着坐在首位的大长老，眼中闪过一丝阴霾，面上却是谦逊的很。
“当然了，区区李家不足为惧，我们先拖着，特别是让林家先跟李家再玩一段时间。”大长老一挥手，捋了捋胡须。
“这其中会不会有诈？”楚家家主有些担忧的问道。
“能有什麽诈？我们身後的可看不上一个小小的清风城，等戍卫操练好军阵，我们就是清风城之主。”大长老摆摆手，有些责备的看了楚家主一眼。
“就是，你这胆子可当不了家主，我们的目标可不单单是小小的清风城了，跟着他们未必不能当一当这世家大族。”二长老也是附和的点了点头。
“长老们教训的是。”楚家家主连忙点头说道，内心也是暗暗後悔。
楚家背後的势力弄死李家就跟捏死一只蝼蚁一样，自己说出这话不就是自己送上把柄吗？
“对了，派人送封信过去，让戍卫们加练，早点练成，虚与委蛇也很累的。”大长老看着楚家家主，吩咐着。
“遵命。”楚家家主低着头，眼神晦涩不明。
而另一边。
李家，大厅。
“楚家绝对有鬼，李武，城郊的事情就麻烦你了。”李毅年看着气质内敛的李武。
“遵命，家主。”李武单膝跪地，沉稳应下。
等到李武离开后。
“多事之秋啊。”李毅年转着茶碗，有些无奈的摇了摇头。
“这也是个机会。”大长老睁开眼，眼神深邃。
“林家嫡子，天赋又回来了。”二长老突然开口。
“一人无用，大势已经来了，楚家都忘了，这清风城，为什麽叫清风城。”李毅年轻轻摇了摇头，淡然的笑了。

三位长老闻言，不约而同点了点头。
街道。
“谢谢你。”林泠看着比自己高半个头的少年道谢。
“不必，当时年少无知，犯下大错，还望姑娘莫往心里去。”李君豪轻笑了一声。
“可他们是楚家”林泠还是好心提醒。
“跳梁小丑罢了，等我二弟”李君豪闻言，本性差点又暴露，幸好关键时刻住了嘴。
“他现在在哪？”林泠被这麽一说，当年夕阳下小小孩童的稚嫩身影清晰的浮现，有些恍惚。
“家事不便告知，你家人来了，在下告辞。”李君豪优雅的一拱手，转身就走入人群消失不见。
他小时候好色差点害了李君肃，从此之後，他沉稳了不少。
城郊，李家。
不知道清风城如此精彩的李君肃，此时正心无旁骛的练着功法。
哪怕最笨的人，愿意下苦功夫来练一招，也不会差到哪去，更何况李君肃如此天才又刻苦的妖孽。
“青龙邀月一定还有后招。”李君肃感受着一种招式强行断开的不适感，喃喃低语。
“二少爷，吃饭了！”就在李君肃思索的时候，李长春打断了李君肃的沉思。
“来了！”李君肃回着。
“算了，先继续把这一招继续精进，再来考虑以後的事情吧。”李君肃摇了摇头。
他现在对於自己的实力还是没有大概的定位，只能继续加强自身，免得自以为无敌一出手就被别人秒了。
宴厅内。
“二少爷，昨日楚夷可是出了一个大风头。
楚大力就不爽了，听说春花楼昨晚的新头牌又死了。”李长春兴致勃勃的开始八卦。

content_en:
Find a new way to dream big.
Chu family, lobby.
"First Elder, do we really want to cooperate with the Li family?" The head of the Chu family looked at the First Elder sitting at the head, with a hint of gloom in his eyes, but his face was very humble.
"Of course, the Li family is nothing to be afraid of. Let's hold off for now, especially let the Lin family play with the Li family for a while." The elder waved his hand and smoothed his beard.
"Is there any fraud in this?" the head of the Chu family asked worriedly.
"What kind of deceit can there be? Those behind us don't look down on a small Qingfeng City. Once the garrison has practiced their military formations, we will be the masters of Qingfeng City." The elder waved his hand and gave the Chu family leader a reproachful look.
"That's right, you are not brave enough to be the head of the family. Our goal is not just the small Qingfeng City. If you follow them, you may not be able to become a big family." The second elder also nodded in agreement.
"The elders taught you a lesson." The head of the Chu family nodded quickly and said, secretly regretting it in his heart.
The forces behind the Chu family killing the Li family is like squeezing an ant to death. If you say this, don't you give yourself a clue?
"By the way, send someone to deliver a letter and ask the guards to practice more so that they can master it as soon as possible. It will be very tiring for them to do nothing." The eldest elder looked at the head of the Chu family and ordered.
"As ordered." The head of the Chu family lowered his head, his eyes unclear.
And the other side.
Li family, lobby.
"There is definitely something wrong with the Chu family, Li Wu. I'll have to worry about things in the suburbs." Li Yinian looked at Li Wu, who had a reserved temperament.
"I obey, Patriarch." Li Wu knelt down on one knee and responded calmly.
Wait until Li Wu leaves.
"It's been such a troubled time." Li Yinian turned the tea bowl and shook his head helplessly.
"This is also an opportunity." The great elder opened his eyes with deep eyes.
"The direct son of the Lin family, his talent has returned." The second elder suddenly spoke.
"One person is useless, the trend has come, and the Chu family has forgotten why this Qingfeng City is called Qingfeng City." Li Yi shook his head lightly and smiled calmly.
When the three elders heard this, they nodded in unison.
street.
"Thank you." Lin Ling looked at the boy who was half a head taller than him and thanked him.
"No need. I was young and ignorant at the time and made a big mistake. I hope the girl won't take it to heart." Li Junhao chuckled.
"But they are the Chu family," Lin Ling reminded kindly.
"You're just a clown, wait for my second brother." Hearing this, Li Junhao almost exposed his true nature again, but luckily he kept his mouth shut at the critical moment.
"Where is he now?" When Lin Ling was told this, the childish figure of the child clearly emerged in the sunset, and she felt a little dazed.
"I can't tell you about family matters. Your family is here. Please take my leave." Li Junhao gracefully cupped his hands, turned around and disappeared into the crowd.
When he was a child, his lust almost killed Li Junsu. Since then, he has become much calmer.
On the outskirts of the city, the Li family.
Li Junsu, who had no idea that Qingfeng City was so exciting, was concentrating on practicing his skills at this time.
Even the stupidest person who is willing to work hard to practice a move will not be any worse, let alone such a talented and hard-working evildoer like Li Junsu.
"Qinglong Yaoyue must have another move." Li Junsu murmured, feeling the discomfort of being forcibly disconnected from the move.
"Second Young Master, it's time to eat!" Just as Li Junsu was thinking, Li Changchun interrupted Li Junsu's contemplation.
"Coming!" Li Junsu replied.
"Forget it, let's continue to improve this move first, and then think about the future." Li Junsu shook his head.
He still doesn't have a rough idea of ​​his own strength, so he can only continue to strengthen himself, lest he think he is invincible and be defeated by others as soon as he makes a move.
In the banquet hall.
"Second Young Master, Chu Yi made a big splash yesterday.
Chu Dali was unhappy. He heard that Chunhualou’s new top star died again last night. "Li Changchun started gossiping enthusiastically.
